ex.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡學習不規則動詞。

ex.en: He works irregular hours.
ex.zh: 他的工作時間不固定。

irregular.en: not following the usual pattern or happening at even times

ex.en: The auditors found some irregular payments.
ex.zh: 稽核人員發現了一些不合規定的付款。

ex.en: This procedure is highly irregular.
ex.zh: 這個程序非常不合規定。

ex.en: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.
ex.zh: 如果有人惹你生氣，最好不要馬上反應。

ex.en: Tom said that he was irritated.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他很煩。

ex.en: He became irritated.
ex.zh: 他開始不耐煩了。

ex.en: This soap may irritate your skin.
ex.zh: 這塊肥皂可能會刺激皮膚。

ex.en: Smoke irritates my eyes.
ex.zh: 煙會刺激我的眼睛。

irritate.en: to make part of the body red, sore or painful

ex.en: Sometimes I find that I basically have no time to pay attention to irrelevant trivia.
ex.zh: 有時候我發現自己根本沒時間理會無關緊要的瑣事。

ex.en: His age is irrelevant to the job.
ex.zh: 他的年齡和這份工作無關。

ex.en: Please remove any irrelevant information from the report.
ex.zh: 請刪除報告中不相關的資訊。

irrelevant.en: not connected to the subject being discussed

ex.en: She finished ironing the clothes a few minutes ago.
ex.zh: 她幾分鐘前燙完了衣服。

ex.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
ex.zh: 先燙領子內側，再燙外側。

iron.en: to make clothes smooth with a hot flat tool

ex.en: I cannot iron my clothes. I have no iron.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法燙衣服，我沒有熨斗。

ex.en: Be careful, the iron is still hot.
ex.zh: 小心，熨斗還很燙。

iron.en: a hot flat tool used to make clothes smooth

ex.en: The gate is made of iron.
ex.zh: 這扇大門是鐵做的。

ex.en: Spinach is rich in iron.
ex.zh: 菠菜富含鐵質。

iron.en: a hard grey metal used to make tools and buildings

ex.en: The farmers built an irrigation system.
ex.zh: 農民建造了灌溉系統。

ex.en: Irrigation is essential in dry areas.
ex.zh: 在乾燥地區，灌溉不可或缺。

irrigation.en: the supply of water to land so that crops can grow

ex.en: Tom said that he was irritated.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他很煩躁。

ex.en: He became irritated.
ex.zh: 他開始生氣了。

ex.en: My eyes are red and irritated from the smoke.
ex.zh: 我的眼睛被煙燻得又紅又痛。

ex.en: The irritated skin needs a few days to heal.
ex.zh: 發炎的皮膚需要幾天才會痊癒。

ironic.zh: 具有諷刺意味的、諷刺的

ex.en: That's ironic, isn't it?
ex.zh: 真諷刺，不是嗎？

ex.en: It's ironic that the fire station burned down.
ex.zh: 消防局竟然被燒毀，真是諷刺。

ironic.en: strange or funny because it is the opposite of what you expect

ex.en: He is always a little irritable in the morning.
ex.zh: 他早上總是有點脾氣暴躁。

ex.en: Irritable men are always the last to know about things.
ex.zh: 脾氣不好的人總是最晚獲知任何訊息。

ex.en: The baby gets irritable when he is tired.
ex.zh: 寶寶累了就會鬧脾氣。

ex.en: The irony is that the fire station itself burned down.
ex.zh: 諷刺的是，消防局本身竟然被燒毀了。

ex.en: She said "great job" with obvious irony in her voice.
ex.zh: 她說「做得好」時，語氣裡帶著明顯的諷刺。

irony.en: a funny or strange situation that is the opposite of what you expect

ironically.zh: 諷刺地、具有諷刺意味地

ex.en: Ironically, the fire station was damaged by a fire.
ex.zh: 諷刺的是，消防局竟然遭受火災。

ex.en: Ironically, he missed the meeting about being on time.
ex.zh: 諷刺的是，他錯過了那場討論準時的會議。

ex.en: "Great job," she said ironically after I spilled the soup.
ex.zh: 我把湯灑出來後，她挖苦地說：「幹得好。」

ex.en: He smiled ironically and clapped his hands slowly.
ex.zh: 他嘲諷地笑著，慢慢地拍著手。

ex.en: Ireland is an island country west of Britain.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭是位於英國西邊的島國。

ex.en: Dublin is the capital of Ireland.
ex.zh: 都柏林是愛爾蘭的首都。

ex.en: The grass in Ireland stays green for most of the year.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭的草地一年中大部分時間都是綠的。

ex.en: The Irish are known for their music and friendly pubs.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭人以音樂和友善的酒館聞名。

ex.en: Some schools in Ireland teach in Irish instead of English.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭有些學校以愛爾蘭語而非英語授課。

ex.en: We listened to Irish music at the small café.
ex.zh: 我們在小咖啡館聽了愛爾蘭音樂。

ex.en: Her grandmother has an Irish accent.
ex.zh: 她的祖母有愛爾蘭口音。

ex.en: She met an Iraqi doctor at the conference.
ex.zh: 她在研討會上認識了一位伊拉克醫生。

ex.en: Many Iraqis enjoy drinking sweet tea with friends.
ex.zh: 許多伊拉克人喜歡和朋友一起喝甜茶。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of ancient Iraqi art.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了許多古代伊拉克藝術品。

ex.en: He cooked a traditional Iraqi dish for the guests.
ex.zh: 他為客人煮了一道傳統的伊拉克菜。

ex.en: Iraq is a country in the Middle East.
ex.zh: 伊拉克是中東的一個國家。

ex.en: The rivers Tigris and Euphrates both flow through Iraq.
ex.zh: 底格里斯河與幼發拉底河都流經伊拉克。

ex.en: Tehran is the capital of Iran.
ex.zh: 德黑蘭是伊朗的首都。

ex.en: Iran is a large country in the Middle East.
ex.zh: 伊朗是中東的一個大國。

ex.en: We tried an Iranian dish made with rice and herbs.
ex.zh: 我們嚐了一道用米飯和香草做成的伊朗菜。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of Iranian carpets.
ex.zh: 這間博物館有大量的伊朗地毯收藏。

ex.en: An Iranian student gave a talk about her hometown.
ex.zh: 一位伊朗學生分享了她家鄉的故事。

ex.en: My neighbor is an Iranian who teaches at the university.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是一位在大學任教的伊朗人。

ex.en: She could not hide her irritation when the meeting ran late.
ex.zh: 會議拖延時，她掩飾不住自己的不耐煩。

ex.en: He sighed in irritation at the constant noise.
ex.zh: 他對持續不斷的噪音惱怒地嘆了口氣。

ex.en: The new soap caused some skin irritation.
ex.zh: 這種新肥皂造成皮膚有些刺激不適。

ex.en: Dust can cause eye irritation and make them red.
ex.zh: 灰塵會刺激眼睛，使眼睛發紅。

ex.en: The iris is the colored part of the eye.
ex.zh: 虹膜是眼睛有顏色的部分。

ex.en: Her iris is a deep shade of brown.
ex.zh: 她的虹膜是深棕色的。

ex.en: Purple irises were blooming along the garden path.
ex.zh: 紫色的鳶尾花沿著花園小徑盛開。

ex.en: She painted a picture of a single iris.
ex.zh: 她畫了一幅單獨一朵鳶尾花的畫。

ex.en: It was irresponsible of him to leave the children alone.
ex.zh: 他把孩子獨自留下，真是不負責任。

ex.en: Driving after drinking is irresponsible and dangerous.
ex.zh: 酒後駕車既不負責任又危險。

ex.en: His fear of small dogs is completely irrational.
ex.zh: 他對小狗的恐懼完全不合理。

ex.en: It is irrational to spend money you don't have.
ex.zh: 花你沒有的錢是不理智的。

irresistible.zh: 無法抗拒的；極具吸引力的

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread was irresistible.
ex.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味讓人無法抗拒。

ex.en: He found her smile irresistible.
ex.zh: 他覺得她的笑容讓人無法抗拒。

ex.en: The store is offering an irresistible discount this weekend.
ex.zh: 這間店本週末推出令人難以抗拒的折扣。

ex.en: The constant noise from the street is really irritating.
ex.zh: 街上不斷的噪音真的很煩人。

ex.en: He has an irritating habit of tapping his pen.
ex.zh: 他有個很討人厭的習慣，老愛敲筆。

ex.en: This soap can be irritating to sensitive skin.
ex.zh: 這種肥皂可能會刺激敏感肌膚。

ex.en: The smoke was irritating to my eyes.
ex.zh: 煙霧刺激得我的眼睛不舒服。

ex.en: The doctor noticed an irregularity in his heartbeat.
ex.zh: 醫生發現他的心跳有不規則的現象。

ex.en: An irregularity in the accounts led to an investigation.
ex.zh: 帳目上的異常引發了調查。

ex.en: The Irishman at the next table spoke with a soft accent.
ex.zh: 隔壁桌的愛爾蘭男子說話帶著柔和的口音。

ex.en: An Irishman, an Englishman and a Scotsman walked into a bar, says the old joke.
ex.zh: 老笑話說，有個愛爾蘭人、一個英格蘭人和一個蘇格蘭人走進酒吧。
